name: founder_hours_per_year
unit: h/yr available to the DAF business
basis: Founder also runs other Echelon Foundry work; low end is adverse. Not a commitment

name: founder_fixed_hours
basis: Finance, legal, insurance, policy ownership, vendor assurance oversight

name: founder_hours_per_customer
basis: Account management, renewals, steering meetings

name: founder_hours_per_new_customer
basis: Pursuit of ~60 h per opportunity divided by a 25% win rate (50%-12.5%) plus contracting (ADV-P-02, ADV-A-11)

name: founder_hours_per_customer_C
basis: Self-serve subscription; renewals by invoice

name: founder_hours_per_new_customer_C
basis: Click-through terms and a short demo

name: founder_hours_per_customer_M
basis: Project steering only; delivery hours are in ACT-MIG

name: founder_hours_per_new_customer_M
basis: Scoping and statement of work; partners may refer projects

name: founder_hours_per_new_customer_W
basis: Partner sells; founder supports the partner's sale

name: founder_imputed_rate
basis: BLS software developer median x ECEC loading / 1600 h (LAB-13); market cost of the founder's time

name: sponsor_staff_rate
basis: Phase II PAR-001 rate_ops (loaded)

name: new_customer_share
unit: share of customers onboarded per year
basis: Steady-state growth assumption; at least one in any year with customers

name: months_to_first_revenue
basis: Phase II CHL-013 sales cycles of 9-24 months; partner-first may be shorter

name: qualification_amortization_years
basis: Phase II PAR-024

name: lic_platform_fee
basis: Reference price only; break-even prices are computed independently

name: lic_per_account
basis: Ren NCF ~$81 per account is the high end (Phase II PAR-012)

name: wl_platform_fee
basis: Wholesale price to a partner; partner keeps its margin

name: wl_per_account
basis: Wholesale per-account price

name: tops_per_account
basis: Operational-support add-on to licensing

name: admin_bps_ref
basis: Reference fee; the 5-30 bps grid is computed separately

name: ci_subscription
basis: Candid Charity Check from $2,750 and Eligibility from $5,000 (CHD rows) as comparables

name: mig_fee_base
basis: Reference migration project fee

name: mig_fee_per_account
basis: Reference per-account migration fee

name: collection_lag_months_L
basis: Annual or quarterly in advance at best; arrears at worst

name: collection_lag_months_W
basis: Partner remits monthly in arrears

name: collection_lag_months_T
basis: As licensing

name: collection_lag_months_F
basis: Asset-based fees accrue and are collected quarterly in arrears

name: collection_lag_months_C
basis: Subscriptions billed annually in advance

name: collection_lag_months_M
basis: Milestone billing

name: employee_overhead
basis: Seats, devices, payroll provider and recruiting amortised (ADV-A-19); BLS ECEC loading excludes them

name: contractor_counts_hours
basis: A contractor with at least this many hours a year in a role counts as one distinct qualified person for coverage (ADV-O-02)

name: customers_added_per_year
basis: Growth path for the capital calculation (ADV-A-01). Held at 2: faster growth is favourable when customers are profitable and adverse when they are not, so it is not oriented in the corners

name: go_live_lead_months
basis: First-customer run-rate incurred before the first invoice: SOC 2 observation, coverage retainers, insurance and evidence must operate at go-live (ADV-P-06, ADV-A-08)
